title: Maintain infrastructure
subtitle: Import without replacement and debug with useful evidence.

delta.before: Imports often meant an isolated terraform import command and hand-written HCL.
delta.after: Use import blocks and generated configuration, then review identities and provider logs.

exercises.title: Log Triage
exercises.description: Isolate an AWS provider permissions failure from a noisy Terraform trace.

cost.assumptions: Short-lived resources, no compute, standard parameters, no uploads; gross usage before account credits.

checkpoints.prompt: Which identifier does an S3 bucket import require?

rationale.a: The AWS provider imports this resource by bucket name.
rationale.b: The address identifies the configuration target, not the remote object.

checkpoints.prompt: Does terraform state rm destroy the cloud object?

rationale.a: It removes the association from state only.
rationale.b: The cloud object remains and needs deliberate ownership/cleanup handling.

checkpoints.prompt: Which setting isolates provider debug logging?

rationale.a: This selects provider logging separately from core.
